ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram shown, which organism consumes the maggot as food?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is a food web. In the lower right there is a maggot labeled “Maggot”, and above and slightly to the right of the maggot there is a bird labeled “Bird”. The arrow connected to the maggot points to the bird. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually indicate that food is transferred to the predator, that is, the arrow points to the organism that eats it. Therefore, the organism that eats the maggot is the bird.
